mechanism: Both drugs can cause photosensitivity and increase risk of pseudotumor cerebri; cephalexin may rarely cause cross-reactivity concerns in patients with penicillin allergy history, though structurally distinct from isotretinoin's mechanisms.
action: Monitor for signs of photosensitivity and intracranial hypertension; counsel patients on sun protection and report headache, visual changes, or nausea; assess penicillin allergy history before cephalexin use.
